dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Millie arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. Her previous owner described her as a social and affectionate dog. While in care, she has been observed to be highly fearful. Noted to have a tense body, tucked tail, and maintains her distance from handlers. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home.
dog.name: Millie
